theses.thesis: The clear challenger (score 1.545, margin only 0.223 behind the leader) with a trend-gate-eligible signal and a non-crowded crowding_z (0.89 vs the leader's 1.01). theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is rank 9 with a negative score (-0.197) despite being eligible and crowded (crowding_z 1.23). The negative momentum and crowding on an eligible theme is a structure to avoid in the trend-gated framework—size-down caution escalates to avoidance when the theme is both crowded AND scoring negatively.
